deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies" > "Returns".
Click on the "Return Policy" section and scroll down to the "Return reasons" section.
Click on the "Add return reason" button to create a new return reason.
In the "Return reason" field, enter the name of the return reason (e.g. "Damaged item") and click "Save".
Copy the "Return reason ID" value, you will need it later.
Navigate to "Online Store" > "Themes" > "Actions" > "Edit code" and select the "layout.liquid" file.
Add the following code snippet to the "layout.liquid" file to embed the returns reason capture form:
<form id="return-reason-form" method="post" action="/orders/{% if order.return_reason %}{{ order.return_reason.id }}{% else %}{% endif %}">
<label for="return_reason">Return Reason:</label>
<select id="return_reason" name="return_reason">
{% for reason in return_reasons %}
<option value="{{ reason.id }}">{{ reason.name }}</option>
{% endfor %}
</select>
<button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
Replace the "return_reasons" variable with the return reasons you created earlier in the "Return Policy" section.
Save the changes to the "layout.liquid" file and click "Save".
Test the returns reason capture form by initiating a return from the Shopify admin panel and selecting a return reason from the form.
Make sure to test the form on different browsers and devices to ensure compatibility.
